_comment: Single source of truth for the game. The app reads name/color/shadow/items[].name; tools/fetch-images.mjs reads tile and items[].wiki to download one photo per card. A wiki value of 'File:Foo.jpg' pins one exact Wikimedia Commons file, used where the article's lead image is a painting, a collage or a diagram. A category marked "drawn": true has no photos to fetch — tools/draw-cards.py renders its cards locally. imageBase is where the app fetches photos from on first run; tools/upload-cloudinary.mjs prints the value to put here.
